# fhwrdh.net

> Photography portfolio of Franklin Henderson, Seattle, Washington.

This is a client-side React application. The HTML source contains no rendered content.
For structured site data, see: https://fhwrdh.net/site-manifest.json

## Pages

- / — Home. Masonry grid of selected photographs.
- /work/ftprtu — First They Passed Right Through Us (Spring 2024). B&W film series paired with music from Steve Roden.
- /work/angleofrepose — Angle of Repose. Photo series.
- /work/iycsmm — If You Can't See My Mirrors. Photo series.
- /work/soundofthesea — Sound of the Sea. Photo series.
- /about — Artist statement and exhibition history.

## Navigation

This site uses hash-based routing. All URLs are formatted as:
https://fhwrdh.net/#/work/ftprtu

Individual images open in a modal carousel at URLs like:
https://fhwrdh.net/#/work/ftprtu/winter-couplet

## Images

All photographs are served from /work/ (e.g. /work/DSCF0156.jpg).
Full image listing with metadata is available in site-manifest.json.
